basic_details.job_title: IIIT Kota Security Supervisor Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The Indian Institute of Information Technology Kota (IIIT Kota) is inviting applications from Indian Nationals for 3 Security Supervisor posts, purely on contract basis, open to retired individuals from the Defence/Paramilitary Forces. Applications must be sent by post to the Registrar, IIIT Kota, Ranpur, Kota, and the last date of submission is 4 December 2026 at 5:00 PM. Pay is Rs.40,000 per month (consolidated) plus Transportation Allowance Rs.4,000 per month.

age_limit.details: Below 58 years. Qualification, experience and age limit are recognized as on 04.12.2026. The notice prints no age relaxation.

qualification.details: The candidate should be a retired individual from Defense/Paramilitary Forces, having served at least as an Ex-Servicemen Supervisor with a Supervisory rank/Junior Commissioned Officer (JCO) in the Army, or holding an equivalent post in the Navy, Air Force, BSF, CISF, CRPF or other paramilitary forces. The candidate should possess a Bachelor's degree from a recognized university or a Graduation Certificate from the Defense/Paramilitary Forces. A minimum of 3 years of supervisory experience in a reputed academic institution or organization is required. The degree should have been awarded by a recognized University/Institute, and only experience gained after the minimum qualifying degree is considered. Only Indian Nationals may apply. | Strong understanding of modern CCTV surveillance systems. Minimum of 3 years of work experience in a reputable academic institution, with at least 3 years of experience at the level of Security Supervisor. Must meet the Shape-I medical standard as per Defense or Central Para Military Force norms. Must be proficient in Hindi and English language. | Below 58 years. Qualification, experience and age limit are recognized as on 04.12.2026. The notice prints no age relaxation. | The monthly remuneration is a consolidated Rs.40,000 plus Transportation Allowance Rs.4,000. There is no annual increment or percentage increase during the contract period, and no House Rent Allowance is admissible. Paid leave of 1.5 days for each completed month of service may be allowed; leave cannot be accumulated beyond a calendar year. For absence from duty, a proportionate deduction is made from the remuneration. No additional remuneration is paid for attending on Saturday, Sunday or other holidays in exigencies of work. | Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility details.

important_instructions: No TA/DA will be paid to attend the selection process (test and/or interview). Candidates from all over the country are encouraged to apply, and female candidates are especially encouraged to apply. Canvassing in any manner entails disqualification of the candidature. The Institute reserves the right not to fill the post, to reject any or all applications, and to modify, defer or cancel the recruitment at any stage without assigning any reason. A false declaration or wilful suppression of material information makes the appointee liable to termination of the contract. The Institute's decision is final; no correspondence or interim inquiries are entertained. Disputes are subject to Courts/Tribunals having jurisdiction over Kota.

content_sections.heading: About IIIT Kota
content_sections.text: IIIT Kota is the Indian Institute of Information Technology Kota, located at SPL-269, RIICO Industrial Area, Kuber Extension, Ranpur, Kota. The notice describes it as an Institute of national importance. The Security Supervisor will work on the IIIT Kota Campus.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Send the completed application in the prescribed format, along with self-attested copies of all original documents, to: The Registrar, Indian Institute of Information Technology, Kota, SPL-269, RIICO Industrial Area, Kuber Extension, Ranpur, Kota -325003, Rajasthan, (India). Superscribe the envelope: "Application for the Post of Security Supervisor" and mention the name of the post on the envelope. The last date of submission of the application form is 4 December 2026 at 5:00 PM. The notice does not mention the postal mode or where the prescribed format can be obtained. Applicants are advised to visit the Institute's website regularly for further updates and information.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The candidate should be a retired individual from Defense/Paramilitary Forces, having served at least as an Ex-Servicemen Supervisor with a Supervisory rank/Junior Commissioned Officer (JCO) in the Army, or holding an equivalent post in the Navy, Air Force, BSF, CISF, CRPF or other paramilitary forces. The candidate should possess a Bachelor's degree from a recognized university or a Graduation Certificate from the Defense/Paramilitary Forces. A minimum of 3 years of supervisory experience in a reputed academic institution or organization is required. The degree should have been awarded by a recognized University/Institute, and only experience gained after the minimum qualifying degree is considered. Only Indian Nationals may apply. Strong understanding of modern CCTV surveillance systems. Minimum of 3 years of work experience in a reputable academic institution, with at least 3 years of experience at the level of Security Supervisor. Must meet the Shape-I medical standard as per Defense or Central Para Military Force norms. Must be proficient in Hindi and English language. Below 58 years. Qualification, experience and age limit are recognized as on 04.12.2026. The notice prints no age relaxation. The monthly remuneration is a consolidated Rs.40,000 plus Transportation Allowance Rs.4,000. There is no annual increment or percentage increase during the contract period, and no House Rent Allowance is admissible. Paid leave of 1.5 days for each completed month of service may be allowed; leave cannot be accumulated beyond a calendar year. For absence from duty, a proportionate deduction is made from the remuneration. No additional remuneration is paid for attending on Saturday, Sunday or other holidays in exigencies of work. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility details.

rows.pay: Rs.40,000/- per month (consolidated) + Transportation Allowance Rs.4,000/- per month

content_sections.heading: IIIT Kota Security Supervisor Job Description
content_sections.text: Oversee all security arrangements for the IIIT Kota Campus and supervise the deployment of watch and ward staff. Handle security arrangements during their shift at the IIIT Kota Campus and supervise the deployment of watch and ward staff. Coordinate with administrative authorities to ensure proper arrangements for events on campus, and liaise with local police stations to address security requirements as needed. Undertake any other related tasks as assigned by the authorities from time to time.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: With the application: Completed application in the prescribed format. Self-attested copies of all original documents. To bring on the day of interview: Filled application form and a detailed CV. A set of self-attested photocopies of academic and/or experience credentials, along with the original certificates. An original Identity proof issued by Government. Two passport size colour photographs.

The Institute reserves the right not to fill the post, to reject any or all applications, and to modify, defer or cancel the recruitment at any stage without assigning any reason. A false declaration or wilful suppression of material information makes the appointee liable to termination of the contract. The Institute's decision is final; no correspondence or interim inquiries are entertained. Disputes are subject to Courts/Tribunals having jurisdiction over Kota.

faq.question: Q1. How many Security Supervisor posts has IIIT Kota advertised?
faq.answer: IIIT Kota has advertised 03 posts of Security Supervisor, purely on contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for IIIT Kota Security Supervisor?
faq.answer: The last date of submission of the application form in the prescribed format is 4 December 2026 at 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for IIIT Kota Security Supervisor?
faq.answer: The candidate must be a retired individual from Defence/Paramilitary Forces with a Supervisory rank/JCO (or equivalent), a Bachelor's degree from a recognized university or a Graduation Certificate from the forces, and minimum 3 years of supervisory experience in a reputed academic institution or organization.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is below 58 years, counted as on 4 December 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the IIIT Kota Security Supervisor?
faq.answer: Rs.40,000 per month (consolidated) plus Transportation Allowance Rs.4,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Send the completed application in the prescribed format with self-attested copies of all original documents to The Registrar, IIIT Kota, SPL-269, RIICO Industrial Area, Kuber Extension, Ranpur, Kota -325003, with "Application for the Post of Security Supervisor" on the envelope.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Shortlisted/eligible candidates will be listed on the Institute website for interview. The Institute may also conduct a selection test apart from the interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is HRA or any allowance paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: No House Rent Allowance is admissible. A Transportation Allowance of Rs.4,000 per month is paid along with the consolidated Rs.40,000.

faq.question: Q9. Can retired defence or paramilitary personnel apply?
faq.answer: Yes, the post is meant for a retired individual from Defence/Paramilitary Forces who served at a Supervisory rank/JCO or an equivalent post, and who meets the other conditions.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job and is TA/DA paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No, the post is purely on contract basis, initially for one year. No TA/DA is paid to attend the selection process.
